fallbackModels.description: Models tried in order when the model keeps failing (after retries) or returns no answer. Never used for account errors (invalid key, no credit).

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for models that reason (OpenRouter reasoning.effort, OpenAI reasoning_effort)

parallelToolCalls.description: Run the tool calls of one model turn concurrently (default true)

traceToolArguments.description: Record each tool call's arguments (secrets redacted, up to 4 KiB) on its trace span

apiKeySecret.description: Secret name holding the API key

openrouter.description: OpenRouter request settings, sent as given (provider: openrouter only)

router.description: Settings for a routing model (typesafe/jev-router, openrouter/auto, openrouter/auto-beta): it picks the model per request, and the model that served each call is recorded.

tier.description: Default cost tier; a task may override it

maxTier.description: Highest tier any task may ask for

budgetTier.description: Tier used once the deployment has spent most (80%) of its daily budget (default low)

script.description: fake provider: path to script, relative to bundle

cassette.description: replay provider: path to cassette, relative to bundle
